status: Phase 8C-14 French production cruiser normalization completed
principles: Known undesirable values may eliminate a candidate.
Unknown or missing values remain eligible and reduce confidence.
Unknown must never be represented as false, no, zero, poor or unsuitable.
Each field answers one defined question and must not duplicate another field.
Model-specific knowledge is ultimately stored with the authoritative boat model record.
Generated views may summarize authoritative model data but must not contain unique model knowledge.
No value may be invented to make a field appear complete.

shortList.itemRule: One concept per item. Use a short phrase or concise sentence. Do not store comma-separated pseudo-lists.
shortList.punctuation: Short fragments omit terminal punctuation; complete sentences use normal punctuation.

unknown.storage: Use null, an empty array, or the explicit controlled value Unknown/NotAssessed according to field type.
unknown.display: Show Unknown or Not assessed when material. Do not convert missing information into a negative result.
unknown.filtering: Unknown remains eligible and reduces confidence.

Overview.question: What is this boat model?
Overview.format: Two to four concise neutral sentences covering general configuration, intended use, layout character, typical propulsion and distinguishing design traits.
Overview.evidenceRequirement: Supported by reliable specifications, period documentation, technical references or consistent model evidence.
Overview.unknownBehavior: Use null. Display 'Overview not yet documented.'
Overview.comparisonUse: Not normally shown; the model header supplies identity.

Suitability.question: How well does this boat model fit defined use cases?
Suitability.format: Keys represent defined use cases. Each value contains Assessment and Summary.
Suitability.evidenceRequirement: Assessment must be traceable to dimensions, configuration, propulsion, documented capability or credible operating experience.
Suitability.unknownBehavior: Use NotAssessed with a null summary. Never infer Limited from missing evidence.
Suitability.comparisonUse: Show selected or materially differentiating use cases only.

Strengths.question: What objective advantages does this boat model provide?
Strengths.format: Two to four concise items for comparison; fuller list permitted in the Boat Guide.
Strengths.evidenceRequirement: Each item must be supported by specifications, design characteristics, technical sources or consistent independent reports.
Strengths.unknownBehavior: Use an empty array. Display 'No documented model-specific strengths yet.'

TradeOffs.question: What compromises are accepted in exchange for this boat model's design and strengths?
TradeOffs.format: Two to four concise items for comparison.
TradeOffs.evidenceRequirement: Must follow from the model's design, layout, dimensions, propulsion, materials or ownership demands.
TradeOffs.unknownBehavior: Use an empty array. Display 'Trade-offs not yet documented.'
mustNotContain: Normal compromise described as a defect

BestFor.question: Which owner, mission or ownership situation is most likely to suit the complete boat model package?
BestFor.format: Two to four plain-language audience, mission or ownership-situation statements.
BestFor.evidenceRequirement: Must synthesize supported suitability, strengths and trade-offs; it may not be generated from Strengths alone.
BestFor.unknownBehavior: Use an empty array. Display 'Best fit not yet assessed.'

AvoidIf.question: Which significant requirements or expectations materially conflict with this boat model?
AvoidIf.format: One to four direct incompatibility statements beginning with a concrete requirement or expectation.
AvoidIf.evidenceRequirement: Must be grounded in a known specification, design characteristic, access limitation, performance boundary or maintenance burden.
AvoidIf.unknownBehavior: Use an empty array. Display 'No model-specific incompatibilities documented.' This does not mean none exist.
mustNotContain: Generic text applicable to every model

KnownConcerns.question: What documented or repeatedly reported problems are associated with this boat model?
KnownConcerns.format: Structured concern objects; one affected system and concern per object.
KnownConcerns.evidenceRequirement: A model-specific concern requires factory documentation, a technical or survey source, or repeated independent reports. A single report must be labelled as such.
KnownConcerns.unknownBehavior: Use an empty array. Display 'No documented model-specific concerns yet.' Do not imply the model has no problems.
mustNotContain: Generic age-related risks presented as model defects
KnownConcerns.comparisonUse: Not reproduced in full; informs Inspection Focus and Boat Guide disclosure.

InspectionFocus.question: What should a buyer or surveyor inspect especially closely on this boat model?
InspectionFocus.format: Three to six concise action-oriented checklist items in the Boat Guide; up to four in comparison.
InspectionFocus.evidenceRequirement: Derived from Known Concerns, documented construction details, meaningful model variations or clearly labelled age-related risks.
InspectionFocus.unknownBehavior: Use an empty array. Display 'No model-specific inspection focus recorded; use an age-appropriate general marine survey.'

BuyerQuestions.question: What should a buyer ask the seller before inspection or survey?
BuyerQuestions.format: Direct questions, each ending with a question mark and addressing one issue.
BuyerQuestions.evidenceRequirement: Derived from Known Concerns, Model Variations, missing material specifications or ownership-sensitive systems.
BuyerQuestions.unknownBehavior: Use an empty array. Display 'No model-specific buyer questions recorded.'
BuyerQuestions.comparisonUse: Boat Guide only unless explicitly expanded.

OwnerActions.question: What practical monitoring, prevention or maintenance actions are especially relevant to this boat model?
OwnerActions.format: Action-oriented items describing what to monitor, prevent, document or address.
OwnerActions.evidenceRequirement: Derived from documented systems, Known Concerns or credible model-specific ownership experience.
OwnerActions.unknownBehavior: Use an empty array. Display 'No model-specific owner actions recorded.'
mustNotContain: Generic maintenance manuals reproduced as model advice
OwnerActions.comparisonUse: Boat Guide and My Boat; not normally shown in model comparison.

ModelVariations.question: Which production, layout, hull, engine, flybridge, cabin, builder or location differences materially affect use, maintenance or value?
ModelVariations.format: Structured variation objects describing the affected period or version and its practical significance.
ModelVariations.evidenceRequirement: Supported by factory documentation, reliable technical references or consistent evidence across examples.
ModelVariations.unknownBehavior: Use an empty array. Display 'Meaningful model variations not yet documented.'
mustNotContain: Cosmetic differences with no practical effect
ModelVariations.comparisonUse: Show only variations relevant to the compared version or a material buying decision.

EvidenceSummary.question: What evidence supports a specific statement, and how certain is that statement?
EvidenceSummary.format: Object containing KnowledgeCoverage, EvidenceQuality, Statements and UnresolvedInformation.
EvidenceSummary.evidenceRequirement: Confidence must reflect the quality, independence, agreement and specificity of cited evidence.
EvidenceSummary.unknownBehavior: Initialize KnowledgeCoverage and EvidenceQuality as Unknown with empty Statements and UnresolvedInformation arrays. Unknown evidence must not create a negative suitability result.
mustNotContain: Confidence inferred from field completeness alone
EvidenceSummary.comparisonUse: Summarize as Research Coverage, Evidence Quality and material Unresolved Information.

EngineCount.Question: How many primary propulsion engines are normally installed?
EngineCount.Purpose: Supports model comparison and the Twin Engines search requirement.
EngineCount.AllowedFormat: 1, 2, or another verified positive whole number; null when unknown or materially configuration-dependent.
EngineCount.EvidenceRequirement: Factory documentation, technical reference, or model-specific configuration evidence.
EngineCount.UnknownState: null. Unknown engine count must not eliminate a model from search.
EngineCount.Comparison: May be shown with propulsion details when known.

labels.Factory documented: Published by the builder or in factory literature/manuals.
labels.Technical or survey source: Supported by a qualified technical reference, survey, service document or recognized specialist source.
labels.Multiple independent owner reports: Repeated by independent owners or communities with no apparent shared source.
labels.Single owner report: Reported by one owner and not independently corroborated.
labels.Marketplace observation: Observed in listings or asking-market patterns; not proof of factory specification or defect prevalence.
labels.Unverified: Claim exists but has not been adequately checked.
labels.Conflicting information: Credible sources disagree or model variations have not been resolved.

evidencePolicy.confidenceScope: Confidence attaches to a fact, statement, concern, variation or defined field—not automatically to the entire boat model.
evidencePolicy.highConfidenceRule: High requires strong, specific and substantially consistent evidence. It must not be assigned solely because a record is complete.
evidencePolicy.conflictRule: Conflicting credible evidence is preserved and displayed; it is not averaged into a false single answer.

applicationScope.purpose: Identify whether evidence applies to one model, a production period, a configuration, a model family or general age-related guidance.

migrationRules.currentPhase: Phase 6 editorial normalization completed. Legacy fields remain temporarily available for traceability and unresolved human review.
migrationRules.Weaknesses: Review and migrate to TradeOffs. Do not automatically treat every weakness as a defect.
migrationRules.TypicalMission: Review and distribute supported content between Suitability and BestFor.
migrationRules.CommonProblems: Review manually. Migrate supported model-specific issues to KnownConcerns and derive InspectionFocus separately.
migrationRules.DataConfidence: Retain temporarily for compatibility. Do not use as statement-level evidence or as a recommendation trigger.
migrationRules.ResearchNotes: Retain as internal legacy research notes until model-specific claims and unresolved information are migrated.
migrationRules.listConversion: Semicolon- or line-delimited lists may be mechanically normalized after audit. Never split narrative prose on commas.
migrationRules.preservation: Ambiguous or unsupported legacy text must be preserved for review, not silently discarded or promoted into approved fields.

Phase5.WeaknessesToTradeOffs: Copy legacy Weaknesses into TradeOffs arrays when TradeOffs is empty; retain Weaknesses temporarily.
Phase5.ListSplitting: Split only on semicolons and line breaks. Never split automatically on commas.
Phase5.Whitespace: Trim leading/trailing whitespace, normalize line endings and repeated horizontal whitespace.
Phase5.Unknowns: Convert only explicit textual unknown markers in nullable text fields to null. Do not reinterpret false, No, or zero.
Phase5.Statuses: Migrate model research stages Favorite/None to Interested, Candidate to Shortlist, Research/Evaluating to Researching. Listing statuses remain separate.

Phase6.Overview: Neutral overviews generated from recorded identity, production, configuration, propulsion and accommodation facts.
Phase6.StructuredIntelligence: The 34 existing structured boat-intelligence records were migrated into Suitability, Strengths, TradeOffs, BestFor, AvoidIf, InspectionFocus and BuyerQuestions.
Phase6.KnownConcerns: Legacy CommonProblems were not promoted without model-specific support; generic age-related risks remain legacy review material.
Phase6.InspectionFocus: Derived only from structured model intelligence or reviewed manufacturer-family guidance, with scope warnings.
Phase6.Evidence: EvidenceSummary now contains scoped statements and conservative coverage/quality labels.
Phase6.Unknowns: Unsupported BestFor, Suitability, KnownConcerns, OwnerActions and ModelVariations remain empty rather than receiving generic filler.
Phase6.Conflicts: Conflicting dimensions are reported and preserved; no value is selected automatically.

migrationRules.phase8A: The 34 preserved structured-intelligence records were normalized into approved fields. Residual non-display research context was archived in ResearchNotes. Supplemental consolidation fields are retired.
migrationRules.phase8C1: Grand Banks family records normalized with model/family evidence scope; legacy content retained but not promoted without support.
migrationRules.phase8C2: Mainship family records normalized with model/family evidence scope; one supported Mainship 34 foredeck-core concern promoted.

retiredFields.Length_ft: Retired in favour of LOA_ft; unique hull-length distinctions retained in HullLength_ft.
retiredFields.IdentityResolution: Moved to boat registry as Resolution.
retiredFields.IdentityResolutionNotes: Moved to boat registry as ResolutionNotes.
retiredFields.BScoutVerdictInComparison: Removed because it duplicated BestFor, Strengths and TradeOffs.
retiredFields.WholeModelKnowledgeConfidence: Replaced by scoped evidence and knowledge coverage.

rules: Suitability initializes as an empty object until defined use cases are assessed.
New list fields initialize as empty arrays.
Existing Strengths and AvoidIf prose is preserved intact as one array item; it is not split or rewritten.
EvidenceSummary initializes with Unknown coverage and evidence quality, no statements, and no unresolved-information assertions.
Legacy Weaknesses, CommonProblems, TypicalMission, DataConfidence and ResearchNotes remain unchanged for later migration.

Reviewed.description: A model record may be marked Reviewed only when the minimum evidence and normalization standard is met.
requirements: At least one credible model-specific source
No unsupported broad High Confidence claims
